RH_ANCN_W_N4P.label: Antenatal Care 4+ Visits
RH_ANCN_W_N4P.definition: Percentage of women age 15-49 with a live birth in the past 5 years who received 4 or more antenatal care visits.

RH_ANCP_W_SKP.label: Antenatal Care from Skilled Provider
RH_ANCP_W_SKP.definition: Percentage of women age 15-49 who attended antenatal care provided by skilled healthcare personnel (doctor, nurse, midwife).

RH_DELA_C_SKP.label: Skilled Birth Attendance
RH_DELA_C_SKP.definition: Percentage of live births attended by skilled health personnel (doctor, nurse, midwife, auxiliary midwife).

RH_DELP_C_DHF.label: Institutional Delivery
RH_DELP_C_DHF.definition: Percentage of live births delivered in a health facility (public or private).

FP_CUSA_W_MOD.label: Modern Contraceptive Prevalence Rate
FP_CUSA_W_MOD.definition: Percentage of currently married women age 15-49 currently using any modern method of contraception.

CM_ECMT_C_IMR.label: Infant Mortality Rate
CM_ECMT_C_IMR.definition: Probability of dying before the first birthday per 1,000 live births for the 5-year period preceding the survey.

CM_ECMT_C_U5M.label: Under-Five Mortality Rate
CM_ECMT_C_U5M.definition: Probability of dying before the fifth birthday per 1,000 live births for the 5-year period preceding the survey.

CH_VACS_C_DP3.label: DPT 3 / Pentavalent 3 Vaccination
CH_VACS_C_DP3.definition: Percentage of children age 12-23 months who received three doses of DPT / Pentavalent vaccine.

CH_VACS_C_MSL.label: Measles Vaccination Coverage
CH_VACS_C_MSL.definition: Percentage of children age 12-23 months who received the first dose of measles vaccine.

CH_VACS_C_BAS.label: Full Basic Immunization Coverage
CH_VACS_C_BAS.definition: Percentage of children age 12-23 months who received all basic vaccinations (BCG, measles, and 3 doses each of DPT and polio).

CN_NUTS_C_HA2.label: Childhood Stunting (HAZ < -2 SD)
CN_NUTS_C_HA2.definition: Percentage of children under age 5 whose height-for-age is below minus two standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.

CN_NUTS_C_WH2.label: Childhood Wasting (WHZ < -2 SD)
CN_NUTS_C_WH2.definition: Percentage of children under age 5 whose weight-for-height is below minus two standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.

CN_NUTS_C_WA2.label: Childhood Underweight (WAZ < -2 SD)
CN_NUTS_C_WA2.definition: Percentage of children under age 5 whose weight-for-age is below minus two standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.

CN_IYCB_C_EXB.label: Exclusive Breastfeeding (< 6 mos)
CN_IYCB_C_EXB.definition: Percentage of infants under age 6 months who are exclusively breastfed.

WS_SRCE_H_IMP.label: Access to Improved Water
WS_SRCE_H_IMP.definition: Percentage of households with access to an improved source of drinking water.

WS_TLET_H_IMP.label: Access to Improved Sanitation
WS_TLET_H_IMP.definition: Percentage of households with an improved, non-shared toilet or sanitation facility.

ED_EDAT_W_SEC.label: Female Secondary Education
ED_EDAT_W_SEC.definition: Percentage of women age 15-49 who have attained secondary education or higher.
